title: Mochizuki Honami — The Power Of Faith〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're doing great, Hona!
You've been staying in rhythm on your bass drum while even hitting all the backbeats!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nice work! You sounded amazing just now, Hona! You've come so far in just two weeks!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've been recording myself during these training sessions to do a before and after comparison... And I was amazed to hear how different I sound now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This means I should do okay tomorrow when we all play together, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
You just gotta keep this up and keep building confidence in yourself!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um... Is now a good time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hm? What's up?
Aren't you assigned to Shih today?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I am, but Shiho finished practicing a little while ago...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was wondering how you were doing since you ran late today...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Rin told me before we started practicing about how she first went to see Shiho by mistake.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha...
B-But it all worked out because Hona's such a great student!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay. As long as you're okay with it, Honami...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And you finally get to play as a band tomorrow. Good luck...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'll do my best to show how far I've come!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
...
But we finally get to play as a band tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I'm sure the others have made significant improvements.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's been so long since we last played together too. Not once since we started doing these training sessions...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Am I going to be able to keep up with her...? Will I be the foundation that supports our band...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That's all going to become clear tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We might not be able to get our song to resonate with Saku or that live house's audience...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The promise I made with Ichika and Saki might...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho honestly believes that we possess the ability to prove Saku wrong and get our music to resonate with everyone at that live house.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, let's do our best... Let's give it everything we have.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know that we've all been doing our best until now to put on good performances...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we're going to have to do even more this time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll need to do absolutely everything in our power so that Shiho will be able to play without holding back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's do absolutely everything we possibly can during these next two weeks to give Shiho a chance to play at her very best!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We may also have to show Shiho just how committed we are tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh no... My hands are starting to shake...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I understand how you all feel.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(We have to do this...
No matter what.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll be fine. I'm sure of it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So...
I'm gonna do my best tomorrow!
